title: Red Hobar Selection
description: A Vanilla-like hotbar selection, but in red for better visibility.
body:
**Red Hotbar Selection** is a small vanilla‑style UI pack that changes the selected hotbar slot highlight to a bright red color for better visibility.  
It keeps the original Minecraft frame shape, only adjusting the color so it is easier to see which slot is active in all lighting conditions.

**_If your are using "Default Dark Mode" Resource Packs, please move my resource pack "Red Hotbar Selection" above it, Otherwise, it won't work._**
